metadata.description: A shareable Claude Code marketplace: autonomous dev-loop guardrails and a portable skill library for shipping software.

plugins.name: dev-loop
plugins.description: Autonomous dev-loop guardrails: protection hooks (no pushes/commits to protected branches, no force-push, no .env/secret writes, no committing live secrets), a SessionStart situational-awareness hook, an end-of-session retro-capture nudge, an optional deterministic notes-vault tidy loop, a Supabase/Stripe/PHI security-reviewer subagent, and the /ship, /babysit-prs, /create-migration, /deploy-edge-function, /retro, /spike skills. Vault features are env-configurable and no-op when no vault is present.

plugins.name: trevor-skills
plugins.description: A portable skill set for shipping software: cracked-dev, skill-forge, sr-fullstack-engineer, sr-security-auditor, deep-research, build-vs-borrow, oss-scout, migration-safety-reviewer, supabase-rls-test-harness, evaluator, and product/strategy skills. Works standalone; notes-vault features are optional.
